field_grid=[r[:] for r in rows[7:]]

from collections import defaultdict
field_by_color=defaultdict(list)
for v,p in fieldcomps:

    bbox=(max(y for y,x in p)-min(y for y,x in p)+1,max(x for y,x in p)-min(x for y,x in p)+1)
    field_by_color[v].append((len(p),bbox,sh,[(y+7,x) for y,x in p]))
for col,objs in sorted(field_by_color.items()):
    print('\nCOLOR',col,'n=',len(objs))
